title: Comma category
description: JSON Schema for a comma category (F ↓ G) — given functors F : A → C and G : B → C with common target, the comma category has as objects triples (a, b, h) with h : F(a) → G(b), and as morphisms compatible pairs (α : a → a', β : b → b') making the obvious square commute (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. II §6; Awodey 2010 §1.6). Generalizes slice categories (G = identity) and arrow categories (F = G = identity).

left-functor.description: The functor F : A → C on the left of the comma.

right-functor.description: The functor G : B → C on the right of the comma.
